posts.title: Welcome to the blog
posts.excerpt: A quieter life, not a smaller one. Here's what you'll find here.
posts.body:
Hi, I'm Mariah! This is where I'll share the simple routines, UGC tips and real-life notes that help me build something of my own while keeping family first.

## What you'll find here

- Easy routines for a calmer home
- Behind the scenes of UGC work
- Honest notes on working from home with two boys

Thanks for being here.
